Watch every goal scored by Kylian Mbappé in the UEFA Champions League as the superstar forward climbs to fifth in the competition's all-time top scorer list!
With 72 goals to his name, Mbappé has already cemented himself in the Champions League history books, delivering on the biggest stage for Monaco, Paris Saint-Germain and Real Madrid.
